purpose: Independent synthetic boundary inputs for approved T18/T20 and L-01/L-03 acceptance. These are not an authorization to delete existing demo data or activate production retention.

regulatoryDateReference.rule: A deliberately fixed synthetic minimum-retention example, separate from any physical demo-lock duration.

shortRawRetentionReference.rule: Explicit seven-elapsed-day test policy only; not a default for regulatory evidence, personal data or production.

deletionGuardCases.retainedReference: An immutable historical report still binds these same content-addressed bytes.

deletionGuardCases.additionalPreconditions: All applicable store/dependency checks and the explicit synthetic data-class policy have succeeded. This does not authorize deletion of unrelated objects.
deletionGuardCases.successRequires: Actual authorized object removal, no stale retrieval projection, and an audit record without copying the deleted raw content.

caseIncludes: An earlier evidence revision bound to a frozen approved report and a newer current revision.
A TransmissionUnknown submission with its exact package scope.
An open fixed-date follow-up and an independently open statutory obligation.
Completed and pending outbox work with their existing receipt/idempotency records.

positiveAssertions: Restored authoritative case, history and frozen-package hashes match the captured consistent source snapshot.
Every restored referenced object exists and matches the source manifest SHA-256, including the earlier evidence revision.
LegalDue, SafetyDue and promised follow-up instants are unchanged; restoring is not a new awareness event.
TransmissionUnknown remains unresolved and cannot trigger an automatic duplicate submission.
Completed work retains its receipt, while genuinely pending work is recoverable without redoing completed external effects.
Search is rebuilt from restored authorized SQL/object sources, not trusted as the source of truth.
The original running demo and its data remain unchanged.

negativeVariants.mutation: Remove one required historical object from the isolated backup.
negativeVariants.expected: Fail or quarantine the incomplete restore explicitly; never report full restoration.

negativeVariants.mutation: Change one byte while retaining the original declared object hash.
negativeVariants.expected: Reject the mismatch before exposing the restore as authoritative.

negativeVariants.mutation: Use an older object snapshot that does not cover the captured SQL references.
negativeVariants.expected: Detect the missing cross-store coverage; do not silently substitute current objects or rewrite frozen evidence.

restoreReference.boundary: This is local functional recovery, not an Azure PITR/region-failover test, externally witnessed ledger proof, or a measured production RPO/RTO commitment.
